title: Rama · The held horizon
scope: Native offline Rama practice; projectiles and guardian field use real lane troops. Hero vitals use explicitly connected practice hazards. No online authority.
design_note: Original mythology-inspired game mechanics. Values are tuning hypotheses, not claims of canonical powers or competitive balance.
clock: lane_army.simulation_stepped; 20 Hz, release on first tick at or beyond windup

abilities.label: Kodanda
abilities.description: Draw and release a precise arrow. Keep moving while drawing.

abilities.label: Piercing Dawn
abilities.description: Commit to a piercing arrow. Damages up to six enemies; solid cover stops it.

abilities.label: Measured Step
abilities.description: Step in your movement direction while keeping your aim. Cover limits the step; no invulnerability.

abilities.label: Guardian Circle
abilities.description: Protect yourself and allied troops in a fixed circle: 55 shield on entry and 10 healing per second.

abilities.label: Dawn Volley
abilities.description: Lock three firing lanes, then release three paced arrows. Each arrow stops at the first enemy or solid cover.
